title: Houthis launch attacks on Saudi airports, echoing 1990 Yemen uprising #shorts
description:
Houthis are attacking Saudi airports, and Yemen has been here before. In 1990 North and South Yemen unified; four years later a peace accord meant to save the union failed within hours.

Opening footage: CENTCOM via DVIDS (public domain). Paintings made for this Short.

#shorts #history #yemen
comment: Which moment marked the point of no return in Yemen's division: the 1994 peace signing or the 1990 unification?
